subject: Request: Temporary rate waiver due to multi-model rollout delay
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@pivotal-analytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@pivotal-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch impact & ask for temporary rate accommodation

Hi Jordan,

Quick note from our side — we ran into a blocker with the multi-model integration that pushed our public launch out by three weeks. The engineering root cause is the model sharding behavior on long sequences; they have a fix in staging but it won't reach prod before our billing period resets.

Given the shift, our customer success team is nervous about unit economics for the ramp month. Procurement asked whether Redwood can provide a short-term rate accommodation (credit or temporary rate reduction) tied to the delayed capability. This would help us preserve the launch cadence with existing customers while we validate the multi-model behavior.

We can share the incident timeline and a proposed usage forecast for the two-week window. Are you able to escalate for a short-term exception? Carlos (copied) is the procurement lead if you prefer to coordinate on PO/terms.

Thanks — Elena

--
Elena Morales
Head of Product, Pivotal Analytics
elena@pivotal-analytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
Attachment: pivotal_incident_timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@pivotal-analytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch impact & ask for temporary rate accommodation

Elena — thanks for the context and the timeline. I reviewed the attached spreadsheet and the two-week forecast looks reasonable as a short, timeboxed ask.

Looping in Karthik and Laura to propose commercial options. My ask to them: can we offer a provisional accommodation (credit or reduced per-token rate) that is:
- Timeboxed to the impacted launch window (max 30 days)
- Contingent on Pivotal submitting the final post-mortem and usage verification
- Documented in a short SOW amendment or a one-page commercial memo

Karthik/Laura — any quick guidance on what level of concession we can authorize without legal signoff, and what requires exec approval? Elena, procurement contact included as well.

Thanks,
Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@pivotal-analytics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch impact & ask for temporary rate accommodation

Jordan / Elena — appreciate the quick heads-up. Commercially we have a couple of pathways:

1) One-time credit equal to the estimated overage from the delayed feature (easiest operationally, quick to approve at my level for <$50k).
2) Timeboxed rate reduction (e.g., -25% per-token for 30 days) — requires manager approval for >$50k impact and exec approval if >$150k or if term exceeds 30 days.
3) Blended option: small upfront credit + reduced rate for a shorter window (two weeks).

For Pivotal's numbers here, the workbook shows ~ $38k delta for the two-week ramp. I can approve a credit up to $50k with an exec notification. Anything beyond that, I'll need Marissa's explicit signoff.

Operational asks: please send the final usage forecast and the post-mortem artifact (we'll tie the credit to specific invoice lines). Also attach a one-page memo outlining acceptance criteria for the accommodation.

Laura — can you spin a short commercial memo and a provisional SOW amendment? Elena — if procurement prefers a PO route, we can accept a PO for the resulting SOW amendment.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Director, Commercials, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@pivotal-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch impact & ask for temporary rate accommodation

Thanks Karthik — I drafted a one-page memo and a provisional amendment to the SOW. Attached is the worksheet with two proposed commercial scenarios:

A) One-time credit of $40,000 (applied to the next invoice) — approved by Karthik at manager-level scope.
B) Two-week rate reduction: 20% off per-token for 14 days (estimated impact $31k) — requires Marissa's exec signoff given precedent and to lock the approach.

If Marissa signs off on B I recommend we:
- Execute the one-page commercial memo and attach the SOW amendment as an exhibit.
- Require the post-mortem and usage verification within 10 business days after the window to reconcile final credit.
- Use a conditional PO or a simple mutually-signed amendment for procurement.

Elena — attaching provisional files: pivotal_sow_v2.pdf and provisional-rate-worksheet.csv. Laura (attachment): provisional-rate-worksheet.csv (CSV, 4KB).

--
Laura Bennett
Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@pivotal-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch impact & ask for temporary rate accommodation

Team — reviewed the memo and the numbers. Given Pivotal's strategic fit and the short, documented window, I approve option B (20% for 14 days) on the condition that:
- The acceptance criteria and post-mortem are submitted within 10 business days after the period
- The credit/reconciliation is limited to the invoiced lines called out in the worksheet
- Legal signs the one-page SOW amendment (Laura, please route)

Jordan — you can confirm to Elena and Procurement that we will proceed with the two-week 20% rate accommodation. Laura, please prepare the final amendment and loop Legal; Karthik, please flag any revenue recognition notes for Finance.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Strategy, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachment referenced: provisional-rate-worksheet.csv
